brief: A clean geometric sans for headlines and short text: built from circles and straight lines, modern and confident, with very even strokes.

why.proportions: Geometric: o and O are circles, and E, F, L, S, B, P and R are narrow, as the brief's 'circles and straight lines' implies.
why.a_g: Single-story a and g are the most circular forms.
why.thin: 82 against a stem of 90 is the very low contrast the brief calls 'even'; horizontals stay slightly thinner so they don't look heavier.
why.stress_deg: 0 is an upright axis, as constructed shapes have no pen angle.
why.x_height: 470 is low against tall ascenders, which gives the classic geometric proportion.
